input.quote: 3.1 The Company shall pay HDI thirty percent (3016) of the Net Sales in excess of Eleven Thousand Dollars ($11,000) per calendar month. "Net Sales" shall mean all revenues from the sale of Deerskin Products on the Site including shipping and handling charges, minus refunds and exchanges.
input.rationale: The fee structure meets the preferred position: the Company owes HDI only a 30% share of actual Net Sales generated on the Site, and only on sales above an $11,000 monthly threshold, so all amounts are purely usage-based. There is no minimum spend, guaranteed order volume, take-or-pay, shortfall or true-up-penalty language anywhere in the Agreement (searches for "minimum", "commit" and the fee article return nothing of that nature), and Section 3.3 provides only a reconciliation for refunds and exchanges, which is a true-up in our favour. The Company also has a clean annual exit on 90 days' notice under Section 4.1. Two adjacent points are noted for completeness but are not MINCOMMIT deviations and are better addressed under the termination-fee and exclusivity rules: the Section 4.2 Termination Payment (12-month Net Sales less $800,000, halved) is an exit fee rather than a volume commitment or shortfall penalty, and the Section 6.1 exclusivity restricts competing online channels rather than capping or committing Company volumes.
